name: B10-0219/2026 (The Left) – Shortcomings and deficiencies of the ‘Amnesty Law’ in Venezuela
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on shortcomings and deficiencies of the ‘Amnesty Law’ in Venezuela
part_text:
This is a statement of opinion, not a change in the law. The European Parliament calls for the release of Venezuela's president, Nicolás Maduro, and his wife, who were taken by the United States. It condemns the United States for using force against Venezuela. It says the new Venezuelan amnesty law matters but must respect human rights rules, and it asks Venezuela to let international human rights monitors in. It also calls for a more independent European foreign policy.

- Nothing changes in law; Parliament only states its position.
- It concerns the United States, Venezuela's government and detainees.
- Parliament sends the text to European Union institutions, member states and Venezuela.
